usage: A common everyday noun for a police officer; use it when talking about law enforcement in general.
Can be used on its own or with a measure word when referring to one officer, e.g. 一位警察 is a natural polite choice.
Neutral and standard in Hong Kong Cantonese; suitable for both spoken and written contexts.
Often appears in public-safety situations, traffic control, crime reporting, and when asking someone to call the police.
